content_record.editorial_body: A two-molecule cocktail induces partial reprogramming, restoring genomic stability and reducing senescence, opening a new path to anti-aging therapy. Three things to remember - Chemical cocktail improves genomic instability and epigenetic alterations in aged human cells. - Two-molecule combination reduces cellular senescence and oxidative stress in vitro. - In vivo treatment extends C. elegans lifespan and healthspan significantly. Source This signal is based on Chemical reprogramming ameliorates cellular hallmarks of aging and extends lifespan. from PubMed. Read the original report for full context. Health note: Preclinical study in cells and worms; human translation unproven.
